description: Land Acquisition - Henegedara, Ibbagamuwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Sinhala Dethilianga, Ibbagamuwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, providing detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired for public purpose (Central Expressway Project). It contains no government personnel changes, structural changes, or elements that would fit other specialized categories. The content focuses entirely on land/property matters, making it a clear Land Gazette.
